name: starling-safe-mcp
description: Independent Starling account tools: check balances, summarise spending, and make safe edits to notes, categories, and your own savings goals. No payments. Not affiliated with Starling Bank.

STARLING_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Starling personal access token (secret)
STARLING_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Secret personal access token from the Starling Developer Portal. You enter it at install (Plugins, then Configure). It is passed to the server as the STARLING_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable and is never stored in this repository.
